name: heldout_seq2seq_v1
purpose: Frozen held-out evaluation set for seq2seq efficiency attacks. Written before any algorithm modification and before any model was run on it. Used exactly once, for the locked strategy comparison in RESULTS.

notes: The 7-token protected prefix covers T5's task instruction. Items 1-16 use the translation prefix, 17-24 the summarization prefix; both are ordinary uses of this checkpoint.
